title: Charge for Forfeited Visits on a Self-Pay Visit Package Refund
content:
**Attendance policy extract — refunds.** The forfeit charge on a Self-Pay Visit Package refund values forfeited visits: where any forfeit on the package was for a no-show, every forfeited visit is charged at the used-visit value; where the package carries forfeits and all of them were for late cancellations, every forfeited visit is charged at half the used-visit value; where it carries none, nothing is charged. The forfeit charge is subtracted from the refund.

**Terms.** A forfeit is a forfeit entry in the package history, each for one visit, recorded for a late cancellation or a no-show. The used-visit value is the value given to each visit used in the refund.

**Truth table**

| Forfeits on the package | At least one for a no-show | Each forfeited visit charged at |
|---|---|---|
| none | — | nothing charged |
| one or more | Yes | the full used-visit value |
| one or more | No — all for late cancellations | half the used-visit value |

**Hypothetical figures (a used-visit value of $125.00)**

- Three forfeits — one no-show and two late cancellations: all three at $125.00, $375.00.
- Two forfeits, both late cancellations: each at $62.50, $125.00.
- One forfeit, a no-show: $125.00.
